hcm6.name: HCM 6 control delay
hcm6.label: Level of service: HCM 6 control delay (signals A ≤ 10, B ≤ 20, C ≤ 35, D ≤ 55, E ≤ 80 s; roundabouts and give-way/stop A ≤ 10, B ≤ 15, C ≤ 25, D ≤ 35, E ≤ 50 s). An approach over capacity (DoS > 1) is F.

sidra.name: SIDRA Delay (roundabouts as signals)
sidra.label: Level of service: SIDRA Delay method (roundabouts on the signals scale A ≤ 10 … E ≤ 80 s; give-way/stop A ≤ 10 … E ≤ 50 s). An approach over capacity (DoS > 1) is F.

rta.name: RTA NSW delay bands (option only)
rta.edition: RTA NSW Guide to Traffic Generating Developments (2002), Table 4.2
rta.label: Level of service: RTA NSW delay bands (A < 14, B < 28, C < 42, D < 56, E < 70 s). An approach over capacity (DoS > 1) is F. Option only; HCM 6 is the default.

pff.name: Peak flow factor
pff.edition: TTOC-06 Traffic Signals Modelling Guidelines; SIDRA default convention

queue.name: Back of queue
queue.edition: HCM 2000 Appendix G (signals, Akçelik form); HCM 6 eq. 20-68 (unsignalised)
queue.note: The 95th-percentile factor of 1.6 is kept until it is checked against HCM 2000 Appendix G.

conv.name: Assignment convergence
conv.note: TAG base models: %GAP under 0.1% and P (links changing flow by under 1%) above 98% for 4 consecutive iterations. NZTA TMDG 2019 asks for convergence to be shown but sets no number.

sidraGap.name: Gap needed for turn volume exports

mbcm.name: NZTA Monetised Benefits and Costs Manual

discount.name: NZTA General Circular 25/01: updated discount rates

mbcm.label: Indicative, IER-equivalent screening estimate; not a funding-approval BCR
mbcm.disclaimer: The benefit-cost ratio is an indicative screening estimate following NZTA Monetised Benefits and Costs Manual v1.7.5 conventions. It is equivalent to an Indicative Efficiency Rating, not a funding-approval BCR. It is not MBCM-compliant unless the full procedures are applied to a model calibrated and validated to the NZTA Transport Model Development Guidelines and independently reviewed. IPM efficiency bands for 2027-30 are shown from NZTA's initial draft (August 2026) and may change after GPS 2027.

growth.name: Background traffic growth
growth.edition: MBCM v1.7.5 arithmetic growth; NZ ITA practice

gaps.name: Critical gaps and follow-up headways
gaps.edition: HCM 6 ch. 20 (TWSC) base values, two-lane major road; mirrored for left-hand traffic
gaps.label: Movement capacities: HCM 6 two-way stop control method (rank impedance, shared and short lanes), mirrored for NZ left-hand traffic; indicative, not SIDRA output.

rbtLanes.name: Roundabout lane capacity
rbtLanes.edition: HCM 6 ch. 22 lane-based entry capacity equations; NZ markings left lane L+T, right lane T+R
rbtLanes.label: HCM 6 roundabout (SIDRA Standard is geometry-sensitive and will differ)

extent.name: Extent of effects (5% / 10% test)
extent.freightBasis: Spare Construct assumption (AT does not define "freight route")

tmdg.name: NZTA Transport Model Development Guidelines
tmdg.standing: TMDG criteria are not a pass/fail checklist; meeting them does not by itself make a model fit for purpose (TMDG s5.8).

msm.name: MSM consistency threshold
msm.notChecked: MSM consistency not checked: AT ITA v2 s4.2.1.1 expects consistency with MSM forecasts where appropriate.

design.name: Design year
design.edition: NZTA RR 422 s5.5; AT ITA Guidelines 2025 v2 s3.6
